item:StoneW6.name: Warped_Weapon_Upgrade_Stone
item:StoneW6.description: Drag onto any Weapon to apply. Success Chance; 50% Uses up 1 item slots. WARNING:Slots are used up even if the Upgrade fails!

item:ExpBalloon1.name: Small_Experience_Balloon
item:ExpBalloon1.description: Hold down to gain EXP in the skill that's displayed in the corner of your screen. If you're in a town, you will gain EXP in the town skill. The amount of EXP you get is based on your skill's Lv.

item:Bullet.name: Bullet
item:Bullet.description: Increases Weapon Power by 1. 15% chance to be consumed every time you defeat a monster. Must be equipped in a Food Slot to give its bonus.
